title: Crackly acoustic
intro: Probe the cables along the acoustic guitar's path.

complaints.says: My guitar keeps crackling and cutting out when I move.

win.label: Acoustic clean in the mains
win.hint: The Acoustic guitar cable is failing. Swap it for a new one.

hints: Crackles that change when someone moves are almost always a cable.
cause: The acoustic guitar's cable was failing, so the signal crackled and dropped whenever it moved.
lesson: When a sound crackles with movement, swap the cable first. Keep spare instrument cables at the stage.
